signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds to scale its AI-powered legal operating intelligence platform

email.body1:
Keegan, saw Filevine raised $400M across two rounds to scale its AI legal operating intelligence platform.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keegan, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keegan, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to peer well-funded software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keegan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
